title: Multi-token whitelist aggregates the nudge-pot so a per-token-safe owner funding can breach the snipe margin in aggregate
description: story-025's whole-whitelist payout pays the qualifying recipient the PRIOR-accumulated pot of EVERY whitelisted nudge token in one event (_payRewards(recipient, snapshot), line 434) for a SINGLE qualifying cost (mint nudgeSize NFTs). Aggregation amortizes that one qualifying cost across N pots: per-token safety (pot_i well under the qualifying cost, the observed run-21 point being pot ~95 USDC vs qualifying cost ~634, a 6.7x margin) does NOT compose. Break-even shifts from 'each pot < qualifying cost' to 'SUM(pot_i) < qualifying cost'. The worthless-NFT sunk-cost defense that made the per-token snipe net-negative does not de-fang the aggregate: profit is denominated in the swept reward tokens and only one mint cost is incurred for N pots.
impact: Config-conditional value leak of owner-funded nudge-reward tokens. No direct unprivileged theft in the default/conservative funding config (which stays within the 6.7x per-token margin); the leak materializes only when the owner funds the whitelist-aggregate such that SUM(pot_i) exceeds one qualifying cost (~7 per-token pots at the observed sizes, fewer if larger). A NON-OBVIOUS Law-3 owner footgun: the safe funding threshold silently migrates from per-token to whitelist-aggregate, and an owner reasoning per-token (as the prior 858e9e80 triage did) would be surprised.
attackPath: 1. Owner whitelists N nudge tokens and funds each pot individually below the per-token snipe margin (per the 858e9e80 disposition: per-token safety = pot_i well under the qualifying cost; observed run-21 point pot ~95 USDC vs qualifying cost ~634, a 6.7x margin).
2. Because the qualifying cost is paid ONCE but ALL pots are swept, per-token safety does NOT compose: break-even shifts from 'each pot < qualifying cost' to 'SUM(pot_i) < qualifying cost'.

3. If the owner funds the whitelist such that SUM(pot_i) exceeds one qualifying cost, a searcher pays nudgeSize*mintPrice once, front-runs/qualifies, and sweeps the aggregate — net-positive even though the minted NFTs carry no redemption value.

4. The worthless-NFT sunk-cost defense that made the per-token snipe net-negative does not de-fang the aggregate: profit is denominated in the swept reward tokens, and only one mint cost is incurred for N pots.
recommendation: Size the WHITELIST-AGGREGATE, not each token, under the qualifying cost: keep SUM(pot_i across all whitelisted tokens) < nudgeSize*mintPrice at all times, OR scale the qualifying cost by the number of tokens paid, OR pay one token per qualifying batch rather than the whole whitelist. Monitor aggregate pot balances against nudgeSize*mintPrice, not per-token balances.
mediumEscalationTrigger: Re-rate to Medium (C4 'value leak with stated assumptions + external requirements') the moment any live/pending deployment funds the whitelist such that SUM(pot_i) approaches or exceeds nudgeSize*mintPrice. This is the AGGREGATE re-expression of the 858e9e80/521c20ad reopen triggers (a)-(e): evaluate them against the whitelist-aggregate, never per token. Feeds ledger note P5; does NOT override the per-token wont-fixes.

No searcher prices that as profit. THE 6.7x MARGIN IS REAL. -- with standing RE-RATE TO HIGH triggers (a)-(e), all phrased PER POT / PER TOKEN against the qualifying cost.
refileDisclosure.refileBasis: story-025 changed the payout object the margin was computed against: batchMint now pays the ENTIRE pot of EVERY whitelisted nudge token to one qualifying recipient. The wont-fix's arming relation (pot vs nudgeSize*mintPrice) was reasoned per token; under the whitelist it must be evaluated on the AGGREGATE SUM of all whitelisted pots. An owner funding N tokens each individually under the margin can breach it in aggregate -- a Law-3 NON-OBVIOUS footgun the prior triage could not have considered (the whitelist did not exist). Distinct root-cause class (cross-token summation); related-not-duplicate.
